---
name: Work, idea or decision
about: Capture a user need or decision without opening a PR
---

## Outcome / user need

Who benefits, and what should become possible? Search existing issues and roadmap #102 first.

## Evidence / options

Link relevant code, source evidence or previous decisions. Distinguish a proposal from approved work.

## Acceptance / next action

Keep this proportional: a short decision may need only one question. Before implementation, record scope/allowed paths, base revision and checks here; a second assignment document is not required for ordinary build work.

## Related work

Link existing issues or PRs; do not duplicate their status. Never include secrets, tokens or private personal data.
